◆ ABOUT US


Motor Sport is the world’s leading independent voice of motor racing. Building on a history, since 1924,covering all aspects of the sport in print, Motor Sport now projects its distinctive voice across all its digital channels sustaining and engaging a growing community of racing fans across the world.

The famous British Racing Green masthead still adorns the magazine, but it has evolved from a text heavy news publication which brought race results from the UK and abroad to eager fans during racing’s golden era in the 1950s and 1960s, into today’s premium magazine focussing on intelligent long-form features, expert analysis and beautiful photography. It covers the modern and historic Formula 1 and Sports Car racing, Le Mans, MotoGP, Road Cars and the growing historic racing scene.

Through its website Motor Sport offers breaking news and informed commentary of the key themes that affect motor racing across all digital platforms sparking conversations and debate among a new generation of readers. Its famous, in-depth podcasts look behind the headlines of contemporary racing and shed new light on developments from a measured and mature perspective.

In everything it does, Motor Sport cuts out the chaff of the overcrowded modern racing market to guide readers to the stories, events and products that matter. What we offer is what matters: the best, most prominent and most significant stories and trends in the motoring world while always keeping one eye on the past.
